verdict.rationale: Auth0 docs explicitly describe an Organizations feature for representing B2B customers/partners, managing their membership, and configuring branded federated login flows per business (auth0-docs-6/24/44/65), plus RBAC for role-based permissions (auth0-docs-7/39/45). However, the evidence pack contains no mention of invitation flows or invitation APIs for organization members, which is a core part of the story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of organization invitation/onboarding flows, and independent/hands-on corroboration of multi-tenant org setup working end-to-end.
